research.title: High-Precision 3D Sensing & Scanning
research.text: Calibration and geometric processing for 3D scanning systems and 3D vision guidance under challenging surfaces and illumination.
research.evidence: Research foundation: tool-free turntable calibration, point-cloud feature extraction, and industrial 3D vision R&D.

research.title: 3D Geometry Understanding & Spatial Representation
research.text: Learning functional structure and orientation-aware representations from 3D point clouds.
research.evidence: Representative work: Upright-Net (CVPR 2022) and Upright-Net+ (IEEE TVCG 2025), alongside valley-ridge feature and 3D fingerprint research.

research.title: Spatial Intelligence & World Modeling for Robotics
research.text: Current research: dynamic scene reconstruction, multimodal spatial perception, object interactions, and physically informed 3D scene representations for robotic manipulation and embodied learning.
research.evidence: Building on 3D-vision-guided robotic systems and research projects in dynamic 3D scanning and general 3D representation learning.
